source_evidence: It can also sell any of the securities in your account to cover any shortfall, without informing you in advance.
question: Misconception: If securities in a margin account lose value, the brokerage firm must give you advance notice before selling them.
answer: Correction: The brokerage firm may sell securities in your account to cover a shortfall without informing you in advance. Even if it gives you a number of days to cover the shortfall, it may sell before that time.
